note: El Salvador: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 180 days (Bolivia 90), with proof of funds and onward documents; everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen, Canadian or US visas may enter: not modelled). Taiwan's exemption ended on 12 December 2018. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Read on 2026-11-03 against the CA-4 classification of visas (El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua, 23 January 2019), the primary the Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería publishes: it gives no lengths and is older than the changes Wikipedia's copy records since, so it is recorded here and not held; where it differs (its categories for some passports), the current figures are kept.
